<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/user-preferences/look"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The user's own choice, the admin defaults (a layout no installed plugin brings reads as null), the default look of the bundled plugins, whether TERMIX_SAFE_LAYOUT forces the repair view, whether TERMIX_SAFE_MODE runs only layout and theme plugins, and installed layout or theme plugins that could not load. The browser resolves the final look from these.
